subject: BrightHarvest — quick intake & demo availability
messages:
From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@brightharvest.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@brightharvest.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:15:12 -0700
Subject: BrightHarvest — quick intake & demo availability

Hi Stephanie,

I signed up via the self-serve flow earlier this morning — thanks for the quick onboarding credits. We are evaluating Redwood primarily for low-latency semantic search and embedding-based reranking across our product catalog and customer support KB. High-level details: 

- Primary use case: embeddings for product search + short-generation reranking (title/summary).
- Expected steady-state: ~10M tokens/month initially (embeddings + small text), growing to ~50M in 6–9 months if pilot succeeds.
- Concurrency: baseline 4–6 qps, peak bursts up to ~12 concurrent requests during traffic spikes and nightly batch re-embedding jobs.
- Typical prompt length: 40–120 tokens for generation; embedding payloads ~1–2k vectors per request at peak.
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in Q3 2026, production by Q4.

Would love a 30–40 min demo to see: hosted latency profiles, suggested batch/kv-cache configs for embedding-heavy workloads, and a brief Dedicated vs Hosted cost/throughput rundown. Are you available next week for a quick walkthrough? Timezone is PST (San Francisco).

Attached a short traffic snapshot (CSV) showing hourly request counts and a tiny sample of our embedding requests.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Lee
Head of ML Infrastructure
BrightHarvest Labs
[attachment: brightharvest-traffic-snapshot.csv]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@brightharvest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:02:45 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightHarvest — quick intake & demo availability

Tom — thanks for the details and for uploading the snapshot, that’s helpful. 

Quick Qs so we can tailor the demo and make the time efficient: 

1) Will you be fine starting on Redwood Hosted for the pilot and then moving to Dedicated or Private later, or do you already need a Dedicated/Private option from day one?
2) For peak bursts (~12 cc), are those sustained multi-minute periods or short spikes (seconds)?
3) Do you need embedding-only throughput guarantees (i.e., high-concurrency embedding pools) or mixed workloads (embedding + generation on same endpoints)?
4) Any compliance/SOC2 requirements we should flag before the call?

If helpful, I can propose three demo slots next week (PST): Tue 05/12 10:00–10:30, Wed 05/13 14:00–14:45, Fri 05/15 09:30–10:15 — please tell me which works best or paste your calendar link and we’ll grab a slot.

Ben — looping you in to lead the live demo since he’s been running embedding-heavy pilots with our infra team.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[redwood.ai]

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@brightharvest.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Ayesha Rahman <ayesha@brightharvest.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 16:30:10 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightHarvest — quick intake & demo availability

Thanks Stephanie — answers inline below.

> 1) Hosted then Dedicated?
We’d prefer to start on Hosted for a 6–8 week pilot (to iterate quickly), with a plan to move to Dedicated if latency/cost tradeoffs push that direction. So Hosted-first is ideal.

> 2) Peak bursts sustained?
Bursts are typically short (30s–3min) when multiple user sessions hit search simultaneously; however nightly re-embedding jobs create 20–30min sustained higher throughput windows.

> 3) Embedding-only throughput?
Initially embedding-heavy (our search pipelines call embeddings for ranking), but we also have occasional generation calls for summaries. It would be great to see both approaches (separate pools vs mixed).

> 4) Compliance/SOC2?
We are SOC2 Type II compliant and will require a standard questionnaire and an outline of data retention/audit logs during the procurement phase, but not blocking the demo.

Preferred demo slots (all PST): Wed 05/13 14:00, Fri 05/15 09:30, Mon 05/18 11:00 — Wed or Fri are best for our team.

Attaching a tiny sample of annotated payloads (zipped) to help Ben tune the demo.

Appreciate the quick follow-up — looking forward to it.

—Tom
[attachment: brightharvest-annotations.zip]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@brightharvest.ai>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightHarvest — quick intake & demo availability

Tom — great, we’ll lock this in. I booked Wed 05/13 14:00 PDT (30 min) — here’s the calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

Pre-demo checklist (few quick asks so we’re ready to show relevant dashboards):
- Can you paste one example prompt/query and one example embedding vector length (or confirm vector dim)?
- Confirm whether the nightly re-embed job runs from 02:00–02:40 PST (we saw the spike in the CSV at that window).
- If you want us to demo Private/Dedicated cost/model tradeoffs, confirm whether procurement requires SOC2 evidence during the pilot or only at contract stage.

If you’re short on time, we can run a focused 30-min session: 10m quick architecture questions, 15m demo live on an embedding workload, 5m next steps.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
